tagline: Leading Asian-American bank providing comprehensive financial services
hero_kpi_rationale: Key indicator of credit quality and credit risk management for a regional bank, reflecting a 21% increase in allowance for credit losses (ACL) in 2025 due to higher loans classified as Special Mention and individually assessed reserves

kpis.name: Allowance for Credit Losses
kpis.explanation: Amount set aside to cover expected credit losses under the CECL methodology
kpis.description: The allowance for credit losses combines the provision for loan losses and the reserve for unfunded credit commitments, calculated under the CECL methodology over the remaining contractual life of the assets
kpis.signal: Significant increase in allowance for credit losses reflecting higher loans classified as Special Mention

kpis.name: Net Credit Losses
kpis.explanation: Net credit losses after recoveries, reflecting the quality of the loan portfolio
kpis.description: Net credit losses represent net charge-offs (charge-offs less recoveries) and are an indicator of the quality of loans extended by the bank
kpis.signal: Increase in net credit losses in 2025

kpis.name: Allowance for Credit Losses Ratio
kpis.explanation: Ratio of allowance for credit losses to gross loans outstanding
kpis.description: The allowance for credit losses to gross loans ratio is an indicator of the quality of loans extended and the coverage of potential credit risks
kpis.signal: Increase in allowance for credit losses ratio from 0.88% in 2024 to 1.03% in 2025

kpis.name: Allowance for Credit Losses 2025
kpis.explanation: Amount set aside to cover expected credit losses in 2025 under the CECL methodology
kpis.description: The 2025 allowance for credit losses reflects the impact of increased loans classified as Special Mention and individually assessed reserves, calculated under the CECL methodology with a reasonable and supportable forecast period of 8 quarters
kpis.signal: Significant increase of $34.1 million in allowance for credit losses in 2025

risks.title: Liquidity Risk
risks.score_rationale: The bank relies on deposits to fund its operations. As of December 31, 2025, the average monthly liquidity ratio was 14.7%, and the bank has an approved credit line with the FHLB of $8.85 billion.

risks.title: Interest Rate Risk
risks.score_rationale: Changes in interest rates directly affect the bank's profitability and the value of its assets. The economic scenarios used in the ACL calculation include interest rate variations across the three scenarios (baseline, upside, and downside).

risks.title: Credit Risk
risks.score_rationale: The bank is exposed to credit risk due to its lending activities. Net credit losses increased by 20% in 2025 to $37.7 million, and the allowance ratio increased to 1.03%.

risks.title: Regulatory Risk
risks.score_rationale: The bank is subject to federal regulations and the CECL methodology for calculating the allowance for credit losses, which may affect its provisions and profitability.

risks.title: Market Risk
risks.score_rationale: The bank is exposed to market risk due to its investment activities. Its available-for-sale securities portfolio was $1.66 billion as of December 31, 2025.
